record.question:
Make the waterfall plot of the maximum
change in tumour metabolism according to standardized uptake values
(SUVmax), measured by PET, for all patients. Save the data as a pd.DataFrame named `data_suv` with two columns
- PATIENT_ID
- SUV
record.answer:
{"reference_answer": "import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the data
data_clinical_patient = pd.read_csv("/workdir/data_clinical_patient.csv")

# Extract the necessary data
data = data_clinical_patient[["PATIENT_ID", "PERCENT_CHANGE_BY_PET"]].dropna()

# Sort the data by the percent change
data_sorted = data.sort_values(by="PERCENT_CHANGE_BY_PET")

data_suv = data_sorted
data_suv.columns = ["PATIENT_ID", "SUV"]

# Create the waterfall plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
bars = plt.bar(range(len(data_sorted)), data_sorted["SUV"], color=(data_sorted["SUV"] > 0).map({True: 'r', False: 'b'}))
plt.xlabel("Patients")
plt.ylabel("Percent Change in Tumor Metabolism (SUVmax)")
plt.title("Waterfall Plot of Maximum Change in Tumor Metabolism (SUVmax)")

# Save the plot
plt.savefig("waterfall_plot.png")
plt.show()
", "test_cases": "assert data_suv["SUV"].max() == 0

assert data_suv["SUV"].min() == -100.0

assert data_suv["SUV"].median() == -100"}
